The structure of Eu₂Nb₄In₈ (Eu(NbIn₂)₂) is orthorhombic with space group Amm2 (No. 38) and 14 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Eu centers with 10 In neighbors, In centers with 12 neighbors (2 In, 4 Nb, 6 Eu), and Nb centers with 9 neighbors (2 In, 5 Nb, 2 Eu). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between 10-vertex Eu polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 12-vertex In polyhedra.
